hook: First close-ups of an asteroid smash.

beats.say: ESA's Hera mission has returned the first close-up images of the impact of the DART asteroid deflection experiment, the crater left behind by the impact.
The pictures show the chaotic aftermath of the cosmic smashup, the scene where a spacecraft deliberately struck an asteroid to shift its path.
It is the first look at what a planetary defence impact really leaves behind in space.
